title: RoCo: A Unified Approach for Multi-Robot Collaboration using Large Language Models

defines.name: RoCo
defines.definition: RoCo is a zero-shot multi-robot collaboration framework that uses LLM agents for natural-language task coordination and for generating sub-task plans and waypoint paths to guide motion planning.

defines.name: RoCoBench
defines.definition: RoCoBench is a benchmark of six multi-robot collaboration tasks designed to evaluate coordination, semantics variation, workspace overlap, and agent capability differences.

problem: Multi-robot systems struggle with high-level task allocation, scalable collision-free motion planning, and generalization to new collaboration scenarios without task-specific engineering.
